mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 70 degrees with overcast skies near Verona Area High School, under a Waning Crescent moon.

The Verona Fire Department is inviting the community to an open house on September 19 from 10 AM until 2 PM. Located at 101 Lincoln Street, the event features tours of the station, meet-and-greets with firefighters, and fire safety activities for everyone to enjoy.

There is plenty to do in Verona today, including live music at Paddy Mac's, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga sessions at Insight Wellness, and Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee. You can also test your knowledge at Trivia Night at The Mill or The Bogey Factory, with more trivia coming up tomorrow at Hop Haus Brewing Company.

On Sunday, August 30, the Verona Police Department began an investigation following a report of an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student. A suspect, 34-year-old Halla Nelson, was subsequently arrested.
The flavor of the day is Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy your favorite treat.
